description: UV index forecast for up to 20 US ZIP codes (EPA) — Today's EPA UV index forecast for up to 20 US ZIP codes (comma separated) in one call: UV index, level and alert per ZIP, plus highest/lowest, count by level, alert ZIPs and where sun protection is advised (UV 3+). Source: US EPA Envirofacts UV forecast (public domain). JSON. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
